AC-001.criterion: Given an approved contract, when intake runs, then every required product-truth section is admitted without loss.

ASM-001.statement: Approved PMOS contracts contain no credentials or customer records.
ASM-001.validation_plan: Reject raw secret values and accept only governed references.

DATA-001.purpose: Trace approved product intent through engineering evidence.
DATA-001.requirement: Retain contract metadata and digests without embedding customer records.

EXT-CONSTRAINT-001.rationale: The repository extension cannot change ownership of product truth.

FR-001.statement: Accept one canonical PMOS contract bundle without inventing missing product truth.
FR-001.title: Canonical contract intake

GUARD-SECURITY-001.description: Contracts must contain references to secrets, never secret values.

METRIC-LEAD-001.definition: Share of received bundles that pass structural validation on first submission.
METRIC-LEAD-001.name: First-pass contract validation rate

north_star.definition: Percentage of approved contract slices deployed with acceptance, SLO, and evidence gates satisfied without manual code modification.
north_star.name: Verified autonomous production delivery rate

NFR-001.evidence_expectation: Deterministic schema and fixture checks pass at the exact commit.
NFR-001.requirement: The same canonical bytes must produce the same validation result.

OBS-001.alert_condition: Any admitted bundle lacks a required evidence reference.
OBS-001.requirement: Record contract admission outcomes and stable subject identifiers.

QUESTION-001.question: Which optional repository extensions will be standardized after MVP?
QUESTION-001.resolution: Defer until extension usage evidence exists.

data_residency.cross_border_transfer_policy: No cross-border transfer without a new product and privacy approval.

deletion.trigger: Approved deletion request or contract-retention expiry

PRIV-001.requirement: Do not embed personal records in the contract bundle.

retention.policy: Retain approved contract metadata for the project lifetime or one year, whichever is shorter.

telemetry.purpose: Measure contract admission quality without collecting product payload values.

hypothesis.falsification_condition: Approved bundles still require engineers to infer material product decisions.
hypothesis.statement: A complete canonical contract will reduce manual engineering handholding.

outcome.measurable_change: More approved slices reach evidence-backed draft PRs without manual engineering intervention.
outcome.statement: Engineering can begin from explicit, approved, traceable product truth.

problem.affected_customers: Product owners and engineering teams using PM Agent OS.
problem.statement: Separate legacy contracts omit required product truth and use incompatible version semantics.

target_customers: Product owners publishing approved PM Agent OS contracts
Engineering teams consuming approved product truth

QA-001.expectation: Valid and invalid canonical fixtures produce deterministic outcomes.

eligible_audiences: Repository maintainers evaluating the draft contract schema

REL-001.expectation: Open one focused draft PR with exact-head evidence.

RISK-001.description: An incomplete schema could falsely admit missing product truth.
RISK-001.mitigation: Require every Phase 0 section and exercise planted invalid fixtures.

rollback.data_loss_tolerance: No rewrite or loss of already registered contract records.

ROLLBACK-001.recovery_evidence: Prior schema remains addressable and registered contracts remain unchanged.
ROLLBACK-001.requirement: Revert the schema PR without rewriting previously registered contracts.
ROLLBACK-001.trigger: Canonical schema admits invalid product truth or breaks declared compatibility.

SEC-001.requirement: Reject embedded credentials and preserve only governed secret references.

CONSTRAINT-001.constraint: Use JSON Schema draft 2020-12 as the normative wire contract.

A11Y-001.requirement: Generated user experiences must satisfy WCAG 2.2 AA.

EDGE-001.condition: A required product decision is absent.
EDGE-001.expected_behavior: Stop with PRODUCT_INPUT_REQUIRED rather than inventing a value.

UX-FLOW-001.goal: Publish an approved contract for engineering intake.
UX-FLOW-001.name: Approve and publish contract

steps.expected_outcome: Approval metadata binds the contract subject.
PEOS receives versioned canonical bytes and provenance.
